messages:
oncall-bot: ALERT: p99 latency crossed 800ms for service=runtime-canary region=us-west-2 :fire:

sam: seeing the alert, thanks. is this limited to canary or also in prod? :eyes:

ben: customer-reported latency spike ~15m ago (acct: acme-inc). They said p95 up from 120ms -> ~420ms. reported via support ticket #3421.

miguel: quick look at metrics: `sum(rate(requests[5m])) by (route)` shows normal qps. p99 spike concentrated on model=redwood-alpha-v2 and route=/stream.

anya: any correlating deploys? IIRC we rolled runtime v2.3.1 to canary at 1799996400 (~10m before alert).

sam: yes canary rollout of runtime v2.3.1. partial traffic ~5%.

miguel: pulled traces from jaeger for that model. I see a lot of spans waiting on `kv_cache_lookup` and then falling back to `cold_kernel` path. tail logs: `kernel_selector: no optimized kernel for seq_len=1536 -> fallback slow-path`

sam: that fits with longer prefix requests from Acme. Did kernel selector change land in v2.3.1?

anya: it did — we tried an aggressive selector that prefers tiled kernels for memory reasons. probably misclassifying tall sequences.

replay-bot: ran replay of a sample acme trace against v2.3.1 canary: avg token latency +70% vs baseline.

miguel: repro steps to confirm locally:
```
# use ri-bench to replay heavy-prefix trace
ri-bench replay --trace acme-2026-03-17.json --model redwood-alpha-v2 --runtime v2.3.1 --concurrency 8
```

sam: thanks. can we hotfix selector or revert?

tara: we can either (A) tweak selector thresholds to prefer optimized kernel for seq_len 1536, or (B) rollback canary to v2.3.0 while we patch. rollback quicker.

miguel: quick mitigation also: enable prefix-KV cache warmup for canary instances for that route, reduces fallback frequency. but config change takes ~5m to propagate.

sam: plan: 1) Rollback canary to v2.3.0, 2) run replay against v2.3.0 to confirm p99 drops, 3) create patch for selector with stricter threshold and run canary again behind a canary flag.

ben: I'll ping Acme support to acknowledge escalation and say we're investigating and running a temporary rollback.

sam: executing rollback now: `kubectl -n runtime rollout undo deployment/runtime-canary --to-revision=1787`

oncall-bot: Deployment event: rollout undo started for runtime-canary by sam at 1799997142

miguel: watching metrics — launching a small synthetic load against /stream to validate.

replay-bot: replay against v2.3.0 shows p99 back to ~160ms (baseline ~120ms).

sam: looks like rollback helped. dashboards show steady decline in p99 over last 2m.

anya: filing a postmortem action: revert the kernel selector change from PR #4267 on canary until we have threshold tests.

tara: also add a canary gating check to our rollout job to run a small prefix-heavy replay before moving traffic beyond 10%.

ben: updated customer: "We deployed a rollback to a prior runtime version; we're continuing to monitor and will follow-up with a permanent fix."

sam: thanks all. follow-ups: miguel to draft selector patch and perf tests, anya to add replay gating, ben to confirm with customer in 30m. close thread when all items created. :white_check_mark:
